answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 31686 Country: India Title: is it a permitted and proper marriage? Question: I am 33 yrs male, I want to marry a poor divorcee girl since she has no proper means of livelihood. I am marrying so that I can fulfil my desires and the same time providing her with monthly maintenance till she finds an adequate means of livelihood ? Is this a proper and valid nikah ? Answer ID: 31686 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 800/800/M=1432) Marrying the poor divorced is permissible rather an act of reward provided there is no reason which may make nikah haram between you and her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
